source.title: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 (with all amendments)
source.publisher: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution, Department of Consumer Affairs
source.reference: GSR 202(E) dated 7th March 2011, as amended up to GSR 226(E) dated 28.3.2022

excludes: packages containing quantity of more than 25 kg or 25 litre (except cement, fertilizer and agricultural farm produce sold in bags above 50 kg)
packaged commodities meant for industrial consumers or institutional consumers
packages with net weight/measure of 10 g or 10 ml or less (except tobacco and tobacco products)
fast food items packed by restaurant or hotel
applicability.note: MVP scope covers only retail packages of food and FMCG categories.

rules.title: Manufacturer / packer / importer details
rules.description: Name and address of the manufacturer. If manufacturer is not the packer, name and address of both manufacturer and packer. For imported packages, name and address of the importer.

rules.title: Country of origin (imported products only)
rules.description: For imported products, the name of the country of origin, manufacture or assembly shall be mentioned on the package.

rules.title: Common / generic name of commodity
rules.description: The common or generic name of the commodity contained in the package must be mentioned. For multi-product packages, name and quantity of each product.

rules.title: Net quantity declaration
rules.description: Net quantity in terms of standard unit of weight/measure/number must be mentioned.

rules.title: Month and year of manufacture
rules.description: Month and year in which the commodity is manufactured shall be mentioned on the package. (Note: 'pre-packed or imported' wording was omitted vide GSR 779(E)/226(E), effective 1.10.2022 - only 'manufactured' date required now.)
exemptions: domestic LPG cylinder of 14.2kg or 5kg marketed by public sector undertaking

rules.title: Best before / use by date
rules.description: If a package contains a commodity which may become unfit for human consumption after a period of time, 'best before or use by' date, month and year shall be mentioned.

rules.title: Retail sale price (MRP)
rules.description: Retail sale price must be declared as maximum price inclusive of all taxes, in Indian currency, in the form 'MRP Rs. xx.xx (incl. of all taxes)' or similar.
exemptions: domestic LPG cylinder priced under Administrative Price Mechanism

rules.title: Consumer complaint contact details
rules.description: Name, address, telephone number and e-mail address of the person/office that can be contacted for consumer complaints.

rules.title: GM food declaration
rules.description: Every package containing genetically modified food shall bear the words 'GM' at the top of its principal display panel.

rules.title: Veg / non-veg mark (soaps, shampoos, toothpaste, cosmetics/toiletries)
rules.description: Every package containing soaps, shampoos, toothpastes and other cosmetics and toiletries shall bear a green dot (vegetarian origin) or red/brown dot (non-vegetarian origin) at the top of its principal display panel.

rules.title: Minimum height of numerals and letters (by Principal Display Panel area)
rules.description: The height of any numeral and letter in the declaration shall be as per Table-I (area-based, post-2017 amendment). Width of letter/numeral shall not be less than one-third of its height, except for numeral '1' and letters i, I, l.

rules.title: Small package principal display panel
rules.description: For packages of capacity 10 cubic cm or less, the principal display panel may be a card or tape affixed firmly to the package.

rules.title: Legible and prominent declaration
rules.description: Every declaration required under these rules shall be legible and prominent.

rules.title: Contrasting colour for MRP and net quantity
rules.description: Numerals of the retail sale price and net quantity declaration shall be printed, painted or inscribed in a colour that contrasts conspicuously with the background of the label. Exception: information blown/formed/molded on glass or plastic surface need not be in contrasting colour. Hand-written/hand-script declarations must be clear, unambiguous and legible.
exemptions: blown/formed/molded label information on glass or plastic surface

rules.title: Language of declaration
rules.description: Particulars of declarations shall be in Hindi (Devanagari script) or English. Use of any other language in addition is not prohibited.

rules.title: Net quantity excludes wrapper/packaging weight
rules.description: In declaring the net quantity of the commodity contained in a package, the weight of wrappers and materials other than the commodity shall be excluded.

rules.title: Free space around quantity declaration
rules.description: The area surrounding the quantity declaration shall be free from printed information: above/below by a space equal to at least the height of the numeral, and to left/right by a space at least twice the height of the numeral.

penalties.rule_32_fine_general: Rs. 5,000 for contravention of any provision with no specific punishment prescribed
penalties.note: Penalty amounts are informational only; app never issues penalties, only flags for officer review.
